documentation: Every CNA-only member reachable on a strict XNA type, and the extension trait that publishes it. The 109 marked movedBy RUST-SURFACE-001 were inherent members of the strict type until that milestone, and the strict verifier reported each as UNEXPECTED_MEMBER; the rest were already extension traits and are gated the same way, so that a member dropped from a trait, or quietly returned to an inherent impl, fails a build.
